descriptions.test_register_customer_success: Verifies POST /api/auth/register with role customer returns 201, success envelope, public user fields, and no password material.
descriptions.test_register_rejects_self_register_non_: Verifies POST /api/auth/register with role admin (or other non-customer) is rejected with 400 and validation messaging.
descriptions.test_login_success_sets_session_cookie: Verifies POST /api/auth/login after register returns 200 and subsequent GET /api/auth/me returns the same user (cookie session).
descriptions.test_auth_me_returns_401_when_unauthenti: Verifies GET /api/auth/me without session returns 401 and standard error JSON.
descriptions.test_logout_clears_session: Verifies POST /api/auth/logout clears session so GET /api/auth/me returns 401.
descriptions.test_login_invalid_credentials_returns_g: Verifies wrong password yields 400 and the generic Invalid email or password message.

error_messages.test_register_customer_success: Customer registration must return 201 with public user JSON only.
error_messages.test_register_rejects_self_register_non_: Self-registration must not allow admin/seller roles.
error_messages.test_login_success_sets_session_cookie: Valid login must establish a session usable by GET /api/auth/me.
error_messages.test_login_invalid_credentials_returns_g: Invalid credentials must return the generic login error message.
